# Spec Review (Early Pass) Checklist: ProjectM-iOS Visualizer

**Purpose**: Test the quality of the requirements writing in spec.md before planning (early,
spec-only pass). Implementation choices are out of scope; the post-plan gate covers them.
**Created**: 2026-11-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Reference key: `§US<n>-AS<m>` = User Story n, Acceptance Scenario m; `§FR-/SC-/RI-` = requirement,
success criterion, or research item IDs; `§Gating` = Delivery Gating; `§Edge` = Edge Cases;
`§Assumptions` / `§OutOfScope` = those sections.

## Requirement Completeness — Capture Modes

- [x] CHK001 - Are start, stop, failure, and labeling requirements all defined for System/App Capture? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-007, §FR-015, §FR-013, §US1]
- [x] CHK002 - Are start, stop, failure, and labeling requirements all defined for Microphone, including the case where no microphone input is available (e.g., input route missing or busy), not only permission denial? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §US2-AS1, §US2-AS2]
- [x] CHK003 - Are failure requirements defined for In-App Playback (e.g., reference track missing or fails to play)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006, §US2-AS3]
- [x] CHK004 - Does the spec define whether In-App Playback is audible through the speaker/headphones, and how the silent switch or zero volume affects it? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK005 - Is there an explicit stop requirement for each fallback mode, or does FR-007 clearly apply to all three modes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §US6-AS1]
- [x] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for the source-switch transition itself (what happens to the old source, what the indicator shows while the new one is in "Waiting")? [Completeness, Spec §US6-AS4, §FR-010]

## Requirement Completeness — User Stories

- [x] CHK007 - Does every user story (US1–US7) have at least one acceptance scenario with a measurable outcome (time, count, or observable state)? [Measurability, Spec §US1–§US7]
- [x] CHK008 - Is "visibly responds to changes in the audio" in US4-AS1 tied to a measurable criterion (e.g., SC-006) rather than left subjective? [Clarity, Spec §US4-AS1, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK009 - Is US5-AS2 ("the browser closes or indicates the active preset") resolved to a single required behavior? [Ambiguity, Spec §US5-AS2]
- [x] CHK010 - Are the export format and delivery method of the diagnostics summary specified enough to be testable? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, §US3-AS1]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the person or role who approves the Stage 2 go/no-go decision identified? [Gap, Spec §Gating, §FR-033]

## Requirement Clarity — Unquantified Terms

- [x] CHK012 - Is "real-time" (Input, US4) bounded by a number or an explicit to-be-measured exit criterion everywhere it appears? [Clarity, Spec §US4, §SC-005, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the "reference device" used in SC-005 and SC-006 identified (model and OS), or is its selection rule stated? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-005, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the threshold for "non-silent"/"Active audio" defined, including whether it differs from the silence threshold (hysteresis) and how quickly the state becomes active? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK015 - Is "repeated rapidly" quantified with an interval between start/stop/switch actions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-052, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK016 - Is "no continuous memory growth" defined with a measurable tolerance (e.g., maximum growth over the session)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK017 - Is "may reduce quality" under low-power or thermal pressure defined (what may change, what must not)? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge]
- [x] CHK018 - Is "supported OS" / "supports System/App Capture" defined by a concrete rule, with its pending dependency on RI-004 explicit everywhere it is used? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008, §US1-AS1, §US1-AS5]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the 150 ms audio-to-visual target given a measurement method that a tester can apply without implementation knowledge? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the "works / partial / does not work" result scale in the compatibility report defined, especially "partial"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-031]

## Truthfulness & Claims

- [x] CHK021 - Does any requirement, story, or success criterion imply universal system-audio capture or guaranteed compatibility with a named app? [Consistency, Spec §FR-062, §FR-030, §US3]
- [x] CHK022 - Is "Receiving audio"/"Active audio" consistently tied to verified non-silent samples in every place the state is mentioned? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §US1-AS1, §US6-AS4]
- [x] CHK023 - Is a single canonical label used for the active state ("Active audio" vs "Receiving audio"), with any synonym explicitly mapped? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK024 - Are public compatibility claims required to be scoped to the device, OS build, and source-app version tested, not just "marked works"? [Gap, Spec §FR-062, §FR-031]
- [x] CHK025 - Does the spec define how sources marked "partial" may (or may not) be described to users and in the store listing? [Gap, Spec §FR-031, §FR-062]
- [x] CHK026 - Does FR-014 define what "from that selection" means when the system prompt does not reveal which app produced the audio? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK027 - Are unsupported-OS requirements consistent between FR-004, FR-008, and US1-AS5 for iOS 26 devices? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008, §US1-AS5]
- [x] CHK028 - Are permission-denial requirements defined for both the microphone and the system capture prompt, including permission revoked after it was granted? [Coverage, Spec §US1-AS4, §US2-AS2, §FR-053]
- [x] CHK029 - Are "no samples" and "silent samples" defined as distinct states with distinct timing thresholds in both stories and requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-011, §FR-012, §US1-AS2, §US1-AS3]
- [x] CHK030 - Is the required outcome after an interruption a single defined behavior per source mode, rather than "resumes or shows interrupted"? [Ambiguity, Spec §US7-AS2, §FR-051]
- [x] CHK031 - Is capture termination by the OS covered by both a requirement and an acceptance scenario, with the exact user-facing reason? [Coverage, Spec §US6-AS3, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK032 - Is the backgrounding outcome ("either resume or show why capture ended") made deterministic per source mode, or explicitly deferred to RI-003 with a placeholder rule? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-050, §US7-AS1, §RI-003]
- [x] CHK033 - Is device lock covered by a functional requirement, not only by the Edge Cases list and RI-003? [Gap, Spec §Edge, §FR-050, §RI-003]
- [x] CHK034 - Are mid-stream audio format changes (sample rate, channel count) covered by a functional requirement rather than only an edge-case bullet? [Gap, Spec §Edge]
- [x] CHK035 - Is the behavior specified when the source app stops playing while capture remains active for a long time (e.g., silent for minutes)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §Edge]

## Privacy

- [x] CHK036 - Is the prohibition on recording, persisting, or uploading audio stated explicitly and without exceptions that conflict with diagnostics export? [Consistency, Spec §FR-060, §FR-061, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK037 - Does the spec define what identifying data (device identifiers, source-app names) the diagnostics export may contain, and that sharing it requires a user action? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, §FR-061]
- [x] CHK038 - Is the scope of on-device persistence limited and enumerated (e.g., favorites only)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-044, §Assumptions]

## Scope & Gating

- [x] CHK039 - Is Stage 1 capture feasibility stated as blocking Stage 2 approval with an objective pass rule? [Completeness, Spec §Gating]
- [x] CHK040 - Is the mapping between the spec's Stage 1/Stage 2 and the constitution's Phases 0–4 and Gates 0–4 stated, so plans and tasks use consistent terms? [Consistency, Spec §Gating, §RI-001–§RI-008]
- [x] CHK041 - Are non-goals explicit and complete, including background visualization (currently only in Assumptions)? [Completeness, Spec §OutOfScope, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK042 - Are accessibility requirements (e.g., VoiceOver labels for source status and controls, Dynamic Type, reduced motion/flashing-content warnings) defined or explicitly deferred? [Gap]
- [x] CHK043 - Is localization in or out of scope for the first release? [Gap]

## Open Questions, Assumptions & Dependencies

- [x] CHK044 - Is every clarify-session item either answered in §Clarifications or recorded as an RI with owner and exit criterion? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications, §RI-001–§RI-008]
- [x] CHK045 - Does each RI name the gate it blocks and the requirement it will update when resolved? [Traceability, Spec §RI-001–§RI-008]
- [x] CHK046 - Do the tunable thresholds (−60 dBFS/2 s, 5 s no-audio, 5 s auto-hide, 55 fps, 150 ms) have an owner and an exit criterion, as the RIs do? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK047 - Is the presumed "iOS 27+" capture boundary labeled as an assumption consistently across Clarifications, FR-008, and Assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, §FR-008, §RI-004]
- [x] CHK048 - Is the dependency on the visualization engine's rendering feasibility (RI-005) reflected in Stage 2 approval, so Stage 2 cannot be approved on capture evidence alone? [Gap, Spec §Gating, §RI-005]
- [x] CHK049 - Is the release-blocking license review (FR-064, RI-007) placed in the delivery timeline, so it is not first discovered at submission? [Gap, Spec §FR-064, §RI-007, §Gating]

## Iteration 3 Additions

- [x] CHK050 - Does FR-066 avoid naming an implementation API (it named UserDefaults), consistent with the spec's technology-agnostic rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-066] (iteration 3)
- [x] CHK051 - Is the exit timing for tunable thresholds consistent with when each can be measured (rendering/device thresholds cannot be finalized in Stage 1)? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions, §SC-014] (iteration 3)
- [x] CHK052 - Does spec §Key Entities include every entity the data model defines (Visualization State was missing)? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities, DM] (iteration 4)
